import json
bl=np.load('base_logits.npy'); ids=json.load(open('all_ids.json'))
pr=json.load(open('pass_30/predictions.json')); idx={r['id']:i for i,r in enumerate(pr)}
lg=np.array([pr[idx[i]]['logits_edited'] for i in ids]); np.save('lg_pass30_m2048v2.npy',lg)
def stress(lg, ks=(1,1.5,2,3)):
    pb=bl.argmax(1); d=lg-bl
    return [int(((bl/k+d).argmax(1)!=pb).sum()) for k in ks]
print('agr',(lg.argmax(1)==bl.argmax(1)).mean(),'stress',stress(lg),'rms',np.sqrt(((lg-bl)**2).mean()).round(4))
